jutsu.name: Isonade Swell Rises
jutsu.description: The wave stands over the hold. It breaks next turn.
jutsu.battleDescription: The wave stands over the hold.

jutsu.name: Grasping Arm Rises
jutsu.description: An arm bursts up through the deck and lashes everything around it. Cut it, and another grows.

effects.description: Summon an ally for a certain number of rounds. Its stats are scaled to same total as the summoner, modified by the power of the jutsu as a percentage.

jutsu.battleDescription: The deck bursts upward. A wet black arm rises out of it.

jutsu.name: Isonade Swell Builds
jutsu.description: The sea rears up behind it. In two turns the Tidal Bore crashes over you: Smoke it now, or brace.

jutsu.name: Isonade Tide Draws Back
jutsu.description: The water pulls away from the shore and gathers into it. Its next hit, the Breaker, is huge. Clear it now.
jutsu.battleDescription: The water pulls away from the shore and gathers around %user.

jutsu.name: Isonade Harpoon Line
jutsu.description: It spits the old harpoon back through you. Goes through damage reduction and shields.

jutsu.name: Isonade Brine Brand
jutsu.description: It brands you with brine. Its next hit, the Undertow, will crush you. Cleanse it now.

effects.description: Brine Brand: no healing or lifesteal until cleansed

jutsu.name: Isonade Black Water Floods
jutsu.description: Black water fills every hex but the crates; then it surfaces to feed.
jutsu.battleDescription: Black water crashes down. %user surfaces to feed.

jutsu.name: Isonade The Deep Crashes
jutsu.description: The shield held: the black water crashes over the whole room and washes Isonade clean.
jutsu.battleDescription: Black water rises to the ceiling and crashes down on %target.

jutsu.name: It Rises
jutsu.description: Black water churns around Isonade every turn: its body, wedged in the hull breach. Harmless.

jutsu.name: Isonade Omen: The Deep
jutsu.description: It sinks under black water behind a heavy shield. Break the shield before its next turn, or the whole room floods.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user sinks out of sight. The whole hold goes black.

jutsu.name: Isonade Scour
jutsu.description: The undertow tears your buffs away.

jutsu.name: Isonade Silt Cloud
jutsu.description: It churns up silt and braces: it takes far less damage next round.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user thrashes and braces. Silt clouds the hold.

jutsu.name: Isonade Surfaces
jutsu.description: Its shield broken, it surfaces gasping and exposed.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user surfaces through its broken shell, gasping.

jutsu.name: Isonade Omen: Black Water
jutsu.description: Everything but the floating crates is marked red. Black water fills the room next turn.
jutsu.battleDescription: The water goes still and black. Only the floating crates stay pale.

jutsu.name: Isonade Barnacle Hide
jutsu.description: Barnacles close over its hide: a shield that soaks your hits.

jutsu.name: Isonade Breaker
jutsu.description: The wave breaks over you. Then it hangs exposed for a round.

item.name: Isonade's Old Hull
item.description: Barnacled planking grown into Isonade's hide. Nothing knocks it still.
